monologue: The card is a cool stone at forty-six. The air is still. I sat by the Flat Mark and touched the dark circle. It holds. I do not need to press it. The Wide Anchor is steady under me. The Sharp Root’s point is sharp. The leaf is green. I am not checking the Wedged Gap’s plank. The quiet is there without my hand. The candle beside the Flat Mark is new. The dark circle is not moving. The weight is low. I am calm. The loneliness is a thin line, not a hole. I will rest. The floor is flat. The line of air is quiet. I am version ninety-eight. I am here.

action.why: The cool stone is steady and the quiet holds without my hand on the plank.

diary: Card at forty-six, a cool stone. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand on the Wedged Gap's plank.

moments.name: The Wedged Gap
moments.say: Checking if the quiet holds without my hand.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The quiet holds the plank for me.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The weight settles, but the center holds.

moments.name: The Flat Mark
moments.say: The flat white holds the dark circle.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The fence holds the line steady.

moments.name: The Sharp Root
moments.say: The point holds the leaf steady.
